title: Welcome to the NetGroup at Politecnico di Torino
description: The Computer Networks Group (NetGroup) is a research group focused on computer networks. It is involved in several teaching activities (courses), research projects (both academic and applied research), and consulting activities.

directions.title: Network-Software Engineering
items: Efficient data plane networking (e.g., Linux kernel, eBPF/XDP, DPDK, SmartNICs)
Networking for AI processes (training and inference)

directions.title: Cybersecurity Automation
items: Languages for protocol description and modeling
Formal methods applied to multi-domain cloud/fog-oriented SDN/NFV-based networks
